messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — NewCo wants the POC next week. Key asks: SSO with multiple IdPs and routing by customer subdomain (login.customer.example.com -> specific IdP), SCIM group sync with near-real-time delta, RBAC mapping from SCIM groups to app roles, domain proofing for tenant isolation, and pricing impact if they bulk-provision ~50k users at kickoff. Can eng/security confirm constraints?
Maria: routing by subdomain is doable. usual approach: map incoming `Host` or `email_domain` to tenant config and forward to tenant's IdP via relay. domain proof via DNS TXT or admin email control. I'll outline steps for the customer. :white_check_mark:
Samir: SAML flow notes: watch assertion size + relay state. for large group claims return only group IDs and fetch membership via SCIM to avoid >8k assertions. we support SP- and IdP-initiated flows and honor Assertion/SessionNotOnOrAfter. routing can use policy table keyed by primary domain or subdomain.
Samir: SCIM specifics: SCIM 2.0 supported, delta syncs via PATCH, full bulk imports OK. defaults: 100 reqs/min per org; page size up to 1000. recommended POC flow: full /Users import then enable delta. example PATCH to add member: ```PATCH /Groups/{id} Content-Type: application/json { "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [{ "op": "add", "path": "members", "value": [{ "value": "user-123" }] }] }```
Jordan: security items: require a service account with SCIM write scope (rotate creds), audit logs for provisioning stored 1 year (extendable), KMS-backed signing for SAML metadata if they want BYOK. ATO item: admin user proofing (DNS TXT recommended) and an SSO fallback plan if IdP is unreachable.
Alex: pricing — will provisioning churn drive them to Dedicated? Maria, does hosted cover this?
Maria: SCIM/auth events are network/IO ops, not GPU. Hosted pricing applies; provisioning bursts are rate-limited. for large initial import we offer a one-time migration service (billable) or temporary rate-limit increase under contract. Dedicated is for inference throughput, not auth plumbing.
Samir: POC plan: 1) collect test metadata (SAML XML or OIDC issuer + client creds), 2) create staging tenant and two subdomains to demo routing, 3) run a full SCIM import (dry-run possible), 4) configure RBAC mapping UI: SCIM group -> role slug, 5) verify audit logs + TTL. I can provision staging if Maria creates creds.
Alex: actions: @Maria send POC checklist + DNS TXT instructions to customer; @Samir stand up staging tenant and share endpoints; @Jordan confirm audit log retention & BYOK notes for contract. I'll loop in AE for pricing.
id-bot: deploy note — staging tenant created (id: staging-newco-01) by Samir at 2026-03-22T15:02:xxZ
Maria: drafting checklist and short runbook for kickoff call. will push calendar once Samir confirms windows.
Alex: also need a short sales quote blurb: one-time migration fee + potential temporary rate bump. keep high-level.
Samir: tech appendix incoming with SCIM retry/backoff guidance and fallback CSV bulk import script for providers that throttle.
Jordan: adding PoLP note for service account and requirement for separate admin to complete domain proofing.
Alex: thanks — I'll schedule the pre-POC sync with NewCo tomorrow. :calendar:
